purpose: Deploy-order manifest for client-called RPCs that do not exist in the live database yet. how_the_list_was_built: Client rpc names (src, api, public-reading-deploy, server, middleware.js) at the release candidate were diffed against origin/main cfda877a1: the only names added by the candidate are push_subscription_upsert_v1 and push_subscription_delete_v1 (DEF-001b). All other names that are absent from supabase/migrations were checked against the live schema on 2026-11-07 (read-only, public.pg_proc) and are listed in supabase/rpc-live-baseline.json or in known_missing_dormant below.
rollout_order: 1. Apply supabase/proposed/20261106121000_def001b_visitor_id_exposure_step1.sql (backward compatible, adds the two RPCs; production DB change, needs ZURIEL approval).

2. Deploy the frontend that calls them. If the frontend goes live first, src/lib/pushSubscriptionStore.js degrades per call to the previous direct table write when the RPC answers PGRST202 / HTTP 404, so subscribe and unsubscribe keep working.
3. Only then apply supabase/proposed/20261106121500_def001b_push_subscriptions_lockdown.sql. Applying it before steps 1 and 2 breaks anonymous Web Push subscribe and unsubscribe.
